mapper.sql: SELECT CONCAT('comment-', c.id) id, 'comment' type, c.created_at occurred_at, p.title, 'post' target_type, p.id target_id FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.post_id=p.id WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status='published' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('favorite-', f.id), 'favorite', f.updated_at, p.title, 'post', p.id FROM post_favorites f JOIN posts p ON f.post_id=p.id WHERE f.user_id=#{userId} AND f.is_favorite=1 AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status='published' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('view-', h.id), 'view', h.viewed_at, p.title, 'post', p.id FROM user_view_history h JOIN posts p ON h.post_id=p.id WHERE h.user_id=#{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status='published' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('checkin-', id), 'checkin', created_at, CONCAT('签到获得 ', points_earned, ' 积分'), NULL, NULL FROM user_checkins WHERE user_id=#{userId} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('achievement-', id), 'achievement', claimed_at, CONCAT(CASE achievement_code WHEN 'read_10' THEN '阅读探索者' WHEN 'comment_10' THEN '热心评论者' ELSE '成就' END, '：领取 ', reward_points, ' 积分'), NULL, NULL FROM user_achievement_claims WHERE user_id=#{userId} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('register-', id), 'register', created_at, '加入了平台', NULL, NULL FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('post-', p.id), 'post', p.created_at, p.title, 'post', p.id FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id=u.id WHERE p.author_id=#{userId} AND u.role='admin' AND p.status='published' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () activity ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, type ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
